summary: Hong Kong, New York, Dubai and Shanghai come fast; Shenzhen, Wuhan and Guangzhou are the surprises, and Tokyo at #11 (200, one short of Kuala Lumpur) is the trap.
reasons: Builder's own replay, pending a real judge. A casual found 7 (Hong Kong, New York, Dubai, Shanghai, Kuala Lumpur, Shenzhen, Bangkok) and lost lives on Tokyo #11, Singapore #13, Chicago #14, Toronto #17 and London #44, each with its count.

Every city is an answer (the world's big-city tables), so one-tower cities cost a life: Paris, Taipei and Seattle show no figure, being under the page's 30-skyscraper floor. The towers themselves (Burj Khalifa, Petronas, Empire State) are free.
62 ranked cities: a casual Blitz scored 24 of 28 names.
fixes: The page counts cities proper, so Metro Manila's 16 cities count apart (Makati #33) and "manila" is free; its height table gives the whole region 215, which would be #6.
Taipei is in the page's height table (39) but not its main ranking, so it shows no figure.
